digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler Jira-family vendor adapter mapping seam
propositions: Rebar reconciler hardcodes Jira project workflow mappings (status, type, priority, link relations, transitions, parent relationships) in three separate modules, preventing support for projects with non-standard workflows without core code changes

A provider-neutral, config-driven mapping seam must be introduced, layered (built-in default → config default block → per-project overlay) and read from rebar.toml [tool.rebar], preserving current hardcoded maps as lowest-precedence defaults

Unmapped or non-representable values must be handled via one of four answers: map to a chosen value, collapse non-injectively (with rebar-type: label for round-trip safety), skip whole-ticket, or drift with warning

Non-allowed transitions must attempt replay by deriving the hop sequence from the core per-ticket STATUS event log and re-attempting each intermediate hop exactly once in recorded order, falling back to drift if the recorded trail is absent or any hop fails
Non-representable parents must drift and leave an echo-safe breadcrumb comment naming the nearest represented ancestor's Jira key

The mapping core must remain provider-neutral (schema, layering, validation, application semantics, and capability descriptor contain no Jira-specific literals; Jira specifics live only in the adapter)
